full_prompt_en: This is a square, intricately drawn cyberpunk illustration of a young adult man with mechanical headgear leaning forward against a dense machine-filled city. His upper body fills the right and lower parts of the frame in side profile, the face turned toward the left. One fist rests against his mouth in a thoughtful pose, while the other forearm crosses the bottom edge. A large circular ear mechanism, layered metal plates, small wires, and dark straps wrap around the head and neck. His short dark hair protrudes above the hardware. A muted magenta shirt covers the shoulders, its rolled sleeve exposing a tattooed upper arm and the carefully drawn muscles of the forearm. A thick pack and tubing rise behind his back, creating a bulky silhouette against the background. The left half is packed with stacked teal buildings, glowing small panels, conduits, grilles, and irregular vertical lines; no single sign can be read. Bright cyan patches punctuate the darker blue-green machinery, while the face and arm receive warmer gray-violet light. Thin black contour lines and tiny hatched marks distinguish skin, cloth, metal, and the urban tangle. A cool ambient glow comes from the city behind and to the left, with small highlights on circular hardware; shadows gather in the neck, under the arm, and between components. The close crop makes the figure feel enclosed by technology rather than placed before a distant skyline. No legible text appears. The overall composition is dense and introspective, with a warm human profile held against an angular turquoise mechanical field.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、线条极细密的赛博朋克插画，一名头部带机械装置的年轻成年男子俯身于机器密布的城市前。他的上半身以侧面占据右侧与下部，脸朝左。一只拳头抵在嘴边，带沉思姿态，另一条前臂横过下边缘。大型圆形耳侧机械、层叠金属板、细小电线与深色绑带包住头颈。短深发从硬件上方露出。低饱和品红衬衫覆盖肩膀，卷起的袖口露出带纹身的上臂和仔细描绘的前臂肌肉。厚重背包与管线从背后升起，在背景前形成鼓胀剪影。左半部塞满层叠青绿色建筑、发亮小面板、导管、格栅与不规则竖线；没有标识能看清。亮青色斑块点亮较暗蓝绿机械，脸和手臂则接受较暖的灰紫色光。细黑轮廓和微小排线区分皮肤、布料、金属与城市纠结结构。冷色环境光从身后和左侧城市照来，圆形硬件上有小亮点；阴影聚在颈部、手臂下和部件之间。紧凑裁切使人物仿佛被技术包围，而非站在远方天际线前。没有可读文字。整体构图浓密而内省，一张温暖的人类侧面位于棱角状青绿机械画域前。
style_prompt_en: The illustrated treatment combines fine black contour, dense micro-hatching, and layered mechanical geometry. Cool teal and cyan occupy the background mass, while muted magenta and gray-violet add a warmer focal counterweight. Small circular highlights punctuate a field of vertical grilles, cables, and rectangular fragments. Overlapping parts compress depth; the nearest surfaces are modeled more smoothly and separated by thicker outlines. Light reads as cool ambient emission with selective bright points rather than one broad daylight source. Texture changes from matte soft areas to hard edged, worn metal, but all are unified by restless linework. The overall effect is crowded, technical, and contemplative, with a clear focal silhouette surviving inside visual complexity.
style_prompt_zh: 这种插画处理结合细黑轮廓、浓密微排线与层叠机械几何。冷青绿与亮青占据背景体量，低饱和品红和灰紫提供较暖的焦点平衡。细小圆形高光点缀在竖向格栅、电缆与矩形碎片组成的画域里。重叠部件压缩纵深，最近处表面塑形更平顺，并由更粗轮廓分隔。光表现为冷色环境发光和选择性亮点，而非宽广日光。肌理从哑光柔软区域变化到硬边、磨损金属，却都由躁动的线条统一。整体效果拥挤、技术感强而带沉思气质，清楚焦点剪影在视觉复杂性中仍然保留。
theme_en: A cybernetically augmented young man leaning over a dense machine-filled city
theme_zh: 一名经过机械改造的年轻男子俯身于机器密布的城市前
name: Biopunk
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
